notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the only tower-specific source: location, elevation, registry number, registration date and administrator. The Forest Lookouts page is a stub with name and county only. No build year, designer, staffing, fire history or access/visit information was found. The Scribd history (a user upload of a 2006 Division of Forestry compilation) is general context on the 1930s tower network and does not name this tower. Florida Memory image pages (items 140289 and 106202) returned HTTP 403, so any photo captions there are unread. Wikidata has a bare label only. The NHLR Florida index shows no rental or visit data for this tower. Recommend a Florida Forest Service or regional newspaper check for the build year before a fuller history. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the register never uses the word standing; the story now attributes only the present-tense placement to it.
